tasks.title: Automated spec validity and traceability
acceptance: Validate all ids/references and schema examples in CI.

tasks.title: Document security boundaries and threat cases
acceptance: Threat table includes injection, exfiltration and irreversible external actions.

tasks.title: Specify functional verification fixtures and acceptance rubric
acceptance: Each SCN-001..005 has expected outputs, authorization gates and failure fixtures; no comparative local model testing.

tasks.title: Implement persistence migrations and event journal
acceptance: Restart retains task and scoped memory events.

tasks.title: Build authorization policy and stop switch
acceptance: No denied tool request reaches executor; stop blocks new actions.

tasks.title: Implement Ollama Qwen3.5 9B adapter and provider-neutral port
acceptance: Configure Ollama qwen3.5:9b from spec/model-config.json; verify text generation and a controlled tool-call smoke check.
Swapping a mock provider in unit tests does not erase task, identity or memory state; do not compare live LLMs.

tasks.title: Implement tool descriptor registry and safe read
acceptance: Reject malformed/out-of-scope paths and missing authorization.

tasks.title: Context assembly, project memory and supersession
acceptance: Historical decision and latest version retrieved with source.

tasks.title: Orchestrator with bounded plan/execute/verify
acceptance: SCN-004 and SCN-005 pass with saved evidence.

tasks.title: Minimal local task interface
acceptance: Owner can inspect planned/running/blocked/completed states.

tasks.title: Calculator and financial numerical verifier
acceptance: Known money fixtures use deterministic calculations and pass.

tasks.title: DOCX/PDF adapter with structure tests
acceptance: SCN-003 passes with diff and no accidental replacement.

tasks.title: XLSX adapter with formula result verification
acceptance: SCN-002 pass and file reopens; formulas and cached results checked.

tasks.title: Browser research adapter and source evidence
acceptance: SCN-001 fixture result contains citations and missing data, no send.

tasks.title: Run business-workflow evaluation matrix
acceptance: All five baseline scenarios have reproducible pass/fail evidence.

tasks.title: Implement durable scheduler and connector-specific reconciliation
acceptance: Persist triggers and bounded retries through restart; connector-specific non-idempotent outcomes require reconciliation.
Scheduler builds on M1 action journal and never auto-replays uncertain effects.

tasks.title: Telegram bot with authenticated status and approvals
acceptance: Unauthorized user rejected, no send without approval.

tasks.title: Project dashboard and searchable history
acceptance: Owner sees why a decision was made and edits permitted records.

tasks.title: Cloud model escalation under egress control
acceptance: Private fixture payload cannot leave host in local mode.

tasks.title: Sandboxed Python and repository workflows
acceptance: Command boundaries/repo diff review preserved.

tasks.title: Reviewed skill proposal, test and activation
acceptance: SCN-006 denied activation before owner approval.

tasks.title: Desktop/CLO adapter feasibility and controlled rollout
acceptance: Supported operations explicitly verified against installed software.

tasks.title: Voice and remote secured client
acceptance: Audio mic switch and remote auth regression pass.

tasks.title: Implement portable assistant home bootstrap, path resolver and migration verification
acceptance: Resolve all configured dirs under ASSISTANT_ROOT; enforce root containment, reject missing G: or denied writes, no fallback.
Provide explicit bootstrap and Windows Ollama env setup flow, with safe migration and DB backup guidance.
CI unit tests cover root override, traversal, directory layout and model path mapping.

tasks.title: Implement stable versioned persona outside model weights
acceptance: Persona+preference records persist across restart and mock provider replacement.
Persona prompt assembly reads versioned identity without rewriting facts.

tasks.title: Implement memory scope, sensitivity and export/egress enforcement
acceptance: Cross-project and private/restricted records are never retrievable through unauthorized task scope.
No private memory or secrets appear in cloud requests, tool arguments or diagnostic logs without approved policy.

tasks.title: Implement scoped hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval
acceptance: Project filter applied before ranked retrieval; provenance and latest/previous decisions returned.
Embedding index may be rebuilt without loss of canonical SQLite evidence.

tasks.title: Implement versioned persona editor and contextual response styles
acceptance: Owner edits/restores persona with audit, without rewriting immutable history.
Context-based work/conversation styles retain shared identity and never modify numeric results.

tasks.title: Implement M1 restart-safe action journal and reconciliation block
acceptance: Crash between dispatch and acknowledgment cannot replay side effect automatically.
Persist approval consumption, operation id and needs_reconciliation state with evidence.

tasks.title: Implement bounded independent task concurrency
acceptance: Two independent read-only tasks run without race; conflicting resource writes serialize.
GPU inference queue and concurrency limits persist across restart.

tasks.title: Implement runtime GPU/CPU/model cost accounting
acceptance: Record token throughput, model residency, p95 latency and GPU memory where available without private payload logging.
Idle model unloading does not interrupt pending approvals or durable tasks.

tasks.title: Implement approval-gated browser mutations
acceptance: Browser form submit is blocked until approved with origin, recipient and exact normalized arguments.
Synthetic hostile page cannot trigger state-changing operation.

tasks.title: Implement email read/draft and approval-gated send
acceptance: Owner-authorized inbox search/drafts work; send requires operation-specific approval.
Retries after uncertain sending do not duplicate messages.

tasks.title: Implement procurement request drafts from verified supplier evidence
acceptance: Prepare supplier outreach drafts with verified source links, units and unknowns.
No outbound messages, purchase or payment without human authorization.

tasks.title: Implement screen perception and gated desktop UI actions
acceptance: Screen parsing and element targeting run on fixture without unauthorized clicks.
Mutation/privileged operations are classified using actual target and action.

tasks.title: Implement scoped personal Telegram integration
acceptance: Authorized personal-account sessions are isolated; read permission does not grant sending.
Sending is blocked pending target-specific approval and logged.

tasks.title: Implement calendar reading and approval-gated event changes
acceptance: Read-only availability works in fixtures; creating/modifying events requires confirmation.
Time zones and duplicate effects are verified.

tasks.title: Document optional future offline fine-tuning feasibility
acceptance: Document opt-in only procedure with curated dataset, independent regression checks, reversible promotion and consent.
No training jobs or model changes are initiated by default.

tasks.title: Validate examples against JSON Schema and run CI on Windows
acceptance: Schema examples validated using a JSON Schema 2020-12 implementation.
CI passes on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest and checks required task coverage.

tasks.title: Define adversarial tool and prompt injection test fixtures
acceptance: Threat cases include forged side effects, GitHub mutation through read intent, browser injection and private memory leakage.
Each threat references an executable future security regression fixture.

tasks.title: Implement memory lifecycle and archival defaults
acceptance: Temporary retrieval cache can expire while canonical decisions remain verifiable.
Owner-scoped retention and rebuildable indexes defined and tested.

tasks.title: Record verified outcomes and propose non-executable skill candidates
acceptance: Verified task outcomes may be distilled into a reviewable, deduplicated skill proposal with provenance.
No generated executable is activated or promoted before owner review (M4 TASK-021).
